name: com.maxence.so-table-editor
description: Edit every ScriptableObject of a given type in one spreadsheet-like window: sort, filter (hp>50 rank=boss), multi-row editing and CSV export. Built for game designers balancing enemies, weapons, towers or items.

samples.description: An EnemyData ScriptableObject (enum, nested struct, color, prefab, list) to try the table right away.
